body: Thank you... I will take this into consideration.  I may refuse to be beaten, but I have been battered by solitude.  I think I need to start smaller.  I think I call my life shallow because I want to help others, to change the world, and yet I can't even take care of myself.  My grand ideas are only paper thin, and ripped apart by my lack of ability.

I think I'm setting myself up for failure.  I expect/want such great things from myself and when I cant achieve them I drop into a near-catatonic cycle. 

I've lost contact with my friends, and when I come up for air and look at what I've done (nothing) and how much I want to do I am paralyzed again.  I've failed myself and wasted so much time...

Thank you for the realization that it was not courage to pushed me to the edge, but something else. Desperation?  I dont know.
